Leah Wasser.instagram:
We are thrilled to share that Leah Wasser will be joining us at EuroPython as one of our keynote speakers! 🚀

Leah is the Executive Director and founder of pyOpenSci, a community of 400+ researchers, engineers, and maintainers working to make developing and maintaining research software more accessible, sustainable, and human. Through open peer review—with 60+ packages reviewed to date—contributor mentorship, and accessible training, pyOpenSci helps scientists build better software and develop the technical skills to participate in open source.

Leah's work sits right at the intersection of open source, open science, and open education—with inclusion at the center. She organizes the Maintainers Summit at PyCon US and believes the communities behind research software matter just as much as the code itself.

As GenAI reshapes how software gets built, Leah is heavily focused on a vital mission: protecting the human networks and reciprocal relationships that make open source sustainable—not just technically, but socially. 🤝

She has built nationally recognized programs at National Ecological Observatory Network (NEON) and the University of Colorado Boulder, holds a PhD in ecology, and is an active open source maintainer. In her free time, you can find Leah on the trails with her rescue pup or at the gym lifting weights and swinging around bars and rings! 🏋️‍♀️🐕

Make sure to join us to hear Leah speak in Kraków, or watch remotely, between 13th and 19th July!

🎟️ Grab your ticket at: europython.eu/tickets

William Woodruff.instagram:
We couldn't be happier to welcome William Woodruff to the EuroPython 2026 speaker lineup! 🎉

William is a Member of Technical Staff at Astral, where he works on building the high-performance, secure tooling that is modernizing the Python developer experience. Prior to Astral, he was an Engineering Director at Trail of Bits, leading high-impact security initiatives across open-source ecosystems. 🛡️

But William's impact on open source stretches far beyond his daily role. He is an active contributor and maintainer across the community:
🛠️ Primary maintainer of zizmor (a security linter for GitHub Actions)
📦 Maintainer of pip-audit, Sigstore, and Homebrew 🍺
Long-term contributor to Python cryptography (PyCA) and packaging (PyPI, PyPA)

When he's not busy protecting our software supply chains, he shares brilliant engineering insights on his blog at blog.yossarian.net.

Don't miss the chance to catch his talk! Join us in Kraków, or watch remotely, between 13th and 19th July. ✈️✨

Get your tickets today: europython.eu/tickets/ 🎟️

We are absolutely delighted to welcome Marlene Mhangami to the EuroPython 2026 speaker lineup! 🎉

Marlene is a Senior Developer Advocate at Microsoft and Github, where she focuses on the cutting edge of Python and AI. As a computer scientist, keynote speaker, and explorer, she is a massive driving force behind community growth across the globe. 🌍

Her impact on open-source leadership is legendary:
📋 Current co-chair of the ACM Practitioner Board
🐍 Previous vice chair of the Python Software Foundation (PSF)
🌍 Lead organizer of the very first PyCon Africa

When she's not busy building the future of Python and AI, she is deeply passionate about empowering the next generation of developers, having co-founded ZimboPy to mentor and teach young girls in Zimbabwe how to code! 💻✨

Imogen Wright.instagram:
We are incredibly proud to welcome Imogen Wright to the EuroPython 2026 speaker lineup! 🎉

Imogen is a Senior Engineer at Amazon EC2, where they focus on making incredibly complex systems behave. Their career spans over two decades of solving high-stakes challenges across theoretical physics, HIV drug resistance, COVID genomics, cloud technologies, and even ad tech! ☁️🧬

Imogen co-founded Hyrax Biosciences, where their Exatype software helps track HIV drug resistance across Africa, and they led the team that assembled the very first Omicron variant SARS-CoV-2 genomes.

Imogen's deep technical expertise is backed by an incredible academic foundation—they hold a PhD in bioinformatics and a master's in theoretical physics. Fun fact: Stephen Hawking was actually the guest of honor at their master's graduation! 🎓

Don't miss the chance to catch their talk! Join us in Kraków, or watch remotely, between 13th and 19th July. ✈️✨

Get your tickets today: europython.eu/tickets/ 🎟️
